IDENT.title: Agent Cooperation Mechanism for Decentralized Manufacturing Scheduling
IDENT.venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems Man and Cybernetics Systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No explicit definition; uses three basic agents from holonic principles (PROSA): resource, product, order agents.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: The proposed model used three basic agents from the holonic principles to investigate decentralized scheduling approach in a manufacturing network.

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: The proposed model used three basic agents from the holonic principles

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: The resource agent becomes an abstraction of the production means such as manufacturers and organizations of manufacturers.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: three types of resource agents namely manufacturer, MP, and manufacturing network

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: Attributes of resource agents can be regarded as the process knowledge [22].

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: Attributes of the job agent form the production knowledge.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: Every instance of resource agents executes a GA.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: The optimization among similar agents is a concurrent activity and saves computational time.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: ran the model in the recursive porous agent simulation toolkit (REPAST)

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: Attributes of the operation agent form the process execution knowledge.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Agents hold attributes (operation plans, due dates, durations); previous GA population reused across iterations.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: the previous population is passed back to the solver at each iteration

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The protocol directs the outputs of six main actions to the right agents at the right time

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: agents had incomplete information about the overall system

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: used to pass inputs, received by agents, to their ﬁtness functions.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: These constitute the messages that were exchanged between agents.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the compromise was regulated by the utilitarian social welfare

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: The chosen method to prune agent interaction was the federated facilitator architecture [20]

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: an agent-based model of the network simulated with recursive porous agent simulation toolkit

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: In terms of make-span, the network achieved a maximum of 1125 which was beyond the known optimal 930.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: the resultant lead time is benchmarked against a known optimum lead time for the MT10 data

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: The study was limited to deterministic scheduling problem and decentralization

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: involves ten manufacturers, ten jobs, and 100 operations

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: scheduling operations in a manufacturing network

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The product agent represents the product model which incorporates the complete operation plans for products

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Introduces manufacturer-pair facilitator agents and network agents doing GA optimization of utilitarian social welfare; offline deterministic scheduling, no capability discovery or reactive replanning.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: This paper introduced MP agents which act as facilitators between two manufacturer agents.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims system architecture is important, not strictly necessary.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: system architecture is an important component of successful decentralized scheduling.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The study was limited to deterministic scheduling problem and decentralization
